commenti.body: I haven't seen it but according to [this article](https://www.silive.com/entertainment/tvfilm/2008/11/gardens_of_the_night_review.html), "the very young actress who plays Leslie (Ryan Simpkins), and the young boy who plays Donnie, her partner in captivity (Jermaine Smith), were purposely kept in the dark about this film's subject matter. Nothing particularly graphic is depicted in the film. It's hardly necessary. "Gardens of the Night" is plenty disquieting thanks simply to the power of suggestion."
Suggestive is a light word for what that was. If they showed anymore it’d be a federal crime 🤮
